name: Bold360
description_en:
Bold360 is a product in the Live chat category. Its directory profile covers Visitor Targeting, Video Chat, Transfers, Shortcut Messages, Offline Form, Knowledge Database, Co-Browsing, Call Me Option.

Additional listed capabilities include Agent Scheduling. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: communicate through live video. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
